answer: My answer to sybils is Pearl stringer polished jewel warrant witnessed by the stone board — each polished jewel is a year of appraisal tables in the guild ledger, so a farm must string a hundred real pearls by hand — which makes the zenith of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the willow of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head. The sonnet is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
